title: Classic Solitaire (v8)
description: Klondike + Spider (3 Decks) with corrected Spider rules: only same-suit descending sequences can be moved or stacked, per the GNOME Aisleriot reference implementation.
prompt: rules for spider are not right - you can only move piles of cards of the same suit https://github.com/GNOME/aisleriot/blob/master/games/spider-three-decks.scm. in other words, if you have a red six on a black 7, you cannot move the 7. but if you have a three of hearts on a four of hearts, you can move the four of hearts and the 3 of hearts etc, as long as they are all the same suit. modify game lib to accept different rules for different games (make sure you do not modify the solitaire game)
